headline: Atul Auto reports 27% drop in Q2 profit despite revenue growth
hook: Margins shrink despite higher sales volume
summary: Atul Auto posted a 27% decline in net profit for the second quarter, even as revenue grew by 34%. EBITDA dropped 25% to ₹14 crore, and EBITDA margin contracted to 5.2% from 9.2% in the same period last year. Rising costs weighed heavily on profitability despite the strong top-line expansion. Retail investors tracking small-cap auto stocks should note the pressure on operating margins.
why_it_matters: Rising costs squeeze margins for auto small-caps

headline: Atul Auto announces financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
summary: Atul Auto Limited has formally submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance numbers for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors track these quarterly disclosures to assess revenue growth, profit margins, and overall operational health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data dictates near-term stock price movement for Atul Auto.
